meta.title: AltDeck – Roblox Alt Manager
meta.description: AltDeck is a free, open-source Windows app that opens several Roblox accounts at once – into the same game, the same server or a friend's game. Unofficial tool.
hero.title: Open all your Roblox accounts at once
hero.text: Tick your accounts, choose a game or a friend, and press Launch. AltDeck keeps every Roblox window open.
hero.note: Free and open source, for Windows 10 and 11. Unofficial tool, not made by Roblox.
how.title: How it works
how.1.title: Close Roblox and open AltDeck
how.1.text: If Roblox is already open, AltDeck shows a button that closes it for you.
how.2.title: Add your accounts
how.2.text: Log in once on the official Roblox login page, inside the app.
how.3.title: Pick a game or a friend, press Launch
how.3.text: Every account opens in its own Roblox window, one after another.
feat.title: What you can do
feat.1.title: Many accounts, one click
feat.1.text: Tick the accounts you want and press Launch. Your choice is remembered for next time.
feat.2.title: Any game
feat.2.text: Paste a game link or a Place ID. Games are saved by name, so you can pick them again from a list.
feat.3.title: The same server
feat.3.text: Put every account in one server with a Job ID, or use a private server link.
feat.4.title: Join a friend
feat.4.text: See which friends are in a game right now and join them with all your accounts.
feat.5.title: Hard to get wrong
feat.5.text: Three clear steps in the app, and a one-click fix when Roblox is already open.
feat.6.title: 10 languages
safe.title: Your logins stay with you
safe.text: AltDeck handles your Roblox logins, so it's built to keep them safe and easy to check.
safe.1: Logins are stored only on your PC, encrypted by Windows.
safe.2: There is no AltDeck server, no tracking and no ads.
safe.3: It only talks to roblox.com and never touches the Roblox game itself.
safe.4: The code is public, and every download is built by GitHub from that code.
shots.title: Screenshots
faq.title: Questions
faq.1.a: Yes. It's free and open source under the MIT license. There are no ads and no paid version.
faq.2.a: No. Your logins never leave your PC except to go to roblox.com, and anyone can read the code to check. Only download AltDeck from this site or the GitHub Releases page, and never send your password or cookie to anyone.
faq.3.q: Can I get banned for using it?
faq.3.a: AltDeck doesn't change Roblox or touch its anti-cheat. But Roblox doesn't officially support running several windows, and some games don't allow alts, so follow each game's rules. No tool can promise you'll never be banned.
faq.4.q: Windows says "Windows protected your PC". What do I do?
faq.4.a: AltDeck isn't code-signed yet, so Windows doesn't recognise it. Click More info, then Run anyway. You can compare the file's checksum with the one on the release page.
faq.5.q: Does it work on Mac, phones or tablets?
faq.5.a: No. AltDeck works on Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit) only.
faq.6.q: My language isn't in the list.
faq.6.a: Each language is a small text file, and anyone can add one on GitHub.
dl.title: Download AltDeck
dl.text: One file, no installer. Windows 10 and 11.
